description: Envoy Gateway data plane and control plane. Counterpart to the NGINX / Ingress controller dashboards, with the overview and nextgen views merged into one.

panels.description: Downstream requests/s accepted by the selected Envoy proxies (HTTP connection manager level).
panels.title: Gateway Request Volume

panels.description: Active downstream connections.
panels.title: Gateway Connections

panels.description: CDS updates accepted per minute - the Envoy analogue of an nginx config reload.
panels.title: xDS Config Updates

panels.description: Rejected CDS + LDS updates in the last 5m. Non-zero means the proxy is serving stale config.
panels.title: Failed xDS Updates

panels.description: Per-route request rate. One Envoy cluster == one HTTPRoute rule (httproute/<namespace>/<name>/rule/<n>). Legend is off - there are too many routes to list; hover to identify a line.
panels.title: Route Request Volume

panels.description: Downstream response codes by class. Stacked, so total height is the overall request rate and each band is one class.
panels.title: HTTP Status Classes

panels.description: Aggregate request rate across everything currently selected.
panels.title: Total HTTP Requests

panels.description: Downstream request time - full client-observed duration, including request upload and response streaming. Envoy's buckets are coarse above 10s, so high percentiles there are interpolated, not measured. The Average series uses _sum/_count rather than bucket interpolation.
panels.title: Latency (Percentiles)

panels.description: Bucket distribution over time. Reveals bimodal latency that percentile lines hide.
panels.title: Latency Heatmap

panels.description: Upstream (backend-facing) latency percentiles per route, over the selected time range. A dash means the route saw no requests.
panels.title: Route Percentile Response Times and Transfer Rates

panels.description: New downstream connections per second, per proxy pod.
panels.title: New Connections Opened (per proxy pod)

panels.description: Reported by Envoy itself, no cAdvisor join required.
panels.title: Average Memory Usage

panels.description: Envoy exports no process CPU stat, so this comes from cAdvisor (kubelet) and needs container metrics in the same Prometheus.
panels.title: Average CPU Usage

panels.description: envoy_server_days_until_first_cert_expiring is in days; multiplied by 86400 so Grafana renders it as a duration.
panels.title: Listener TLS Health and Certificate Expiry

panels.description: Legend is off - one series per route is too many to list; hover to identify a line.

targets.expr: sum(rate(envoy_cluster_upstream_rq_xx{gateway_namespace=~"$gateway_namespace", gateway=~"$gateway", pod=~"$pod", envoy_cluster_name=~"$route", envoy_response_code_class!~"4|5"}[${__range_s}s])) by (envoy_cluster_name) / sum(rate(envoy_cluster_upstream_rq_xx{gateway_namespace=~"$gateway_namespace", gateway=~"$gateway", pod=~"$pod", envoy_cluster_name=~"$route"}[${__range_s}s])) by (envoy_cluster_name)

panels.title: Success Rate (non-4|5xx) by Route

panels.description: Three percentiles per route, so the series count is 3x the route count. Legend is off; hover to identify a line.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(envoy_cluster_upstream_rq_time_bucket{gateway_namespace=~"$gateway_namespace", gateway=~"$gateway", pod=~"$pod", envoy_cluster_name=~"$route"}[5m])) by (le, envoy_cluster_name))

histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(envoy_cluster_upstream_rq_time_bucket{gateway_namespace=~"$gateway_namespace", gateway=~"$gateway", pod=~"$pod", envoy_cluster_name=~"$route"}[5m])) by (le, envoy_cluster_name))

histogram_quantile(0.90, sum(rate(envoy_cluster_upstream_rq_time_bucket{gateway_namespace=~"$gateway_namespace", gateway=~"$gateway", pod=~"$pod", envoy_cluster_name=~"$route"}[5m])) by (le, envoy_cluster_name))

panels.title: Latency by Route

panels.description: Current backlog in the control plane's internal message bus. Sustained growth means reconciliation is falling behind; 0 is healthy.
panels.title: Watchable Queue Depth

panels.description: Config snapshots pushed to proxies over the selected range.
panels.title: xDS Snapshot Updates (range)

panels.description: Kubernetes objects the infrastructure manager wrote - the Deployments, Services and ConfigMaps behind the proxy fleet.
panels.title: Resources Applied (range)

panels.description: Panics recovered in the watchable infrastructure. Must be 0 - anything else means the control plane hit a bug and kept running in an unknown state.
panels.title: Recovered Panics (range)

panels.description: How long each runner takes to handle a message off its queue. The runners are the pipeline stages (provider -> gateway-api -> xds -> infrastructure); whichever rises is the bottleneck.
panels.title: Watchable Subscribe Duration (p99 by runner)

panels.description: Events published per stage. High publish volume plus rising subscribe duration is where backpressure starts.
panels.title: Watchable Publish Volume (5m)

panels.description: Status subresource writes per Gateway API kind. Constant churn on one kind usually means a resource is flapping between accepted and rejected.
panels.title: Status Updates by Kind (5m)

panels.description: Latency of status writes to the API server - a direct read on API server pressure or admission webhook delay.
panels.title: Status Update Duration (p99 by kind)

panels.description: Deletes are drawn negative. Sustained simultaneous apply and delete of the same kind means two controllers are fighting over an object.
panels.title: Resource Apply / Delete by Kind (5m)

panels.description: Config pushes per proxy node. One node updating far more than its peers points at a gateway whose config keeps being recomputed.
panels.title: xDS Snapshot Updates by Node (5m)

panels.description: xDS streams are long-lived, so this is normally flat at 0. Repeated closures mean proxies are reconnecting to the control plane - check that before trusting any data-plane config.
panels.title: Completed xDS Streams (5m)

title: Envoy Gateway / Gateway API
